text:
hiro.sales: FYI Newgate just put their POC on hold. Procurement says they need a signed data-residency attestation + a firm pilot spend cap before legal will issue the PO. Requesting a quick 20m sync today with Sec/Eng.

 eva.presales: I can host. Do we have a one-page attestation Legal will accept or should Sec draft something custom? Also, clarify whether the cap is a total for the 30-day trial or weekly.

 sam.sec: We have a standard attestation we can adapt: region lock, no outbound raw-data egress w/o approval, 90-day audit logging. Need to confirm KMS preference (BYOK vs Redwood KMS) and if they need an HSM attestation.

 ben.eng: For Dedicated/VPC pilot we can provision in ~72h. On-prem would add 3+ weeks. If they require model pinning + quantized variant for compliance, we'll want to run a short compatibility test with their sample corpus.

 nina.csm: Procurement insists on a hard ceiling to avoid invoice surprises. Finance must approve any figure. I can surface their exec sponsor once we have a signed attestation.

 eva.presales: Draft pricing to present: 30-day pilot, Dedicated VPC, optional BYOK, pilot cap $6,500 total or $0.00085/token on overage (customer-favoring). Can Finance/Rev confirm?

 sam.sec: OK to present that as a draft. Draft attestation for Legal review:

 sam.sec: ```
Data Residency Attestation (draft)
- Customer data processed only within region: eu-west-3.
- No export of raw customer data outside the region without express customer approval.
- Customer may elect BYOK; Redwood supports either customer-managed keys or Redwood KMS with HSM.
- Inference request audit logs retained for 90 days and made available on request.
```

 hiro.sales: @workflow-bot please open an internal ticket to track approvals and owners.

 workflow-bot: Created ticket SD-6322 (Newgate POC BoardHold). Assigned: eva.presales, sam.sec, legal-team.

 ben.eng: Risk note: if they require deterministic outputs from a pinned model, cache warming and batching will affect latency. Recommend a 45min validation run against their sanitized samples before the exec call. Who will upload samples?

 nina.csm: Uploading sanitized samples to the secure share now and inviting Eng/Sec.

 eva.presales: @finance-team can you confirm the $6.5k cap for 30 days? If not, what's the fallback? Need an answer before we send to their CTO/CISO.

 sam.sec: Legal asked to include an addendum: "Redwood to provide SOC2 report and completed security questionnaire within 48 hours of request." Getting legal eyes now.

 ben.eng: Reserving a staging Dedicated slot. If BYOK, start KMS onboarding paperwork (24-48h).

 eva.presales: Proposed plan: 1) Send draft attestation + pricing cap to customer today, 2) schedule 20-30m CTO/CISO call tomorrow with our execs, 3) run compatibility test once samples are in. Target: PO released by Friday EOD if Legal/Finance sign-off.

 workflow-bot: SD-6322 status updated -> "awaiting legal review"

 hiro.sales: Great work team. If Legal signs fast, I'll request exec intro now. If not, we should be ready to escalate to the VP of Sales for board pressure. Keep updates in SD-6322.

 nina.csm: Customer DM: VPC is acceptable for the pilot unless audit explicitly requires on-prem. I'll communicate the draft and propose 10am or 3pm for the exec sync.

 eva.presales: 3pm works for our execs. I'll send the invite with draft attestation once Legal signals green.

 sam.sec: One last ask 14 please confirm whether they require physical air-gapped on-prem for the pilot. That would change timelines significantly.

 hiro.sales: Closing loop 14 legal review started. Will update SD-6322 and post the signed attestation here when available. Thanks everyone for the quick turnaround.
